name: 04416 · Bucksport, ME
findings: ZIP 04416 (Bucksport) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04416 (Bucksport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
